entries.en: Is there anyone who doesn’t know about those great friends Harry, Hermione and Ron in the Harry Potter books?
entries.zh: 有谁不知道《哈利·波特》里哈利、赫敏和罗恩那几个好朋友吗？

entries.en: JK Rowling’s stories are world famous and part of their success is because of the friendship between those three main characters.
entries.zh: JK·罗琳的故事举世闻名，成功的一部分原因就是这三位主角之间的友谊。

entries.en: But there are many examples of great friends in literature.
entries.zh: 但文学作品中还有很多好朋友的例子。

entries.en: Let’s look at some more.
entries.zh: 我们来看几个。

entries.en: In 1844 French writer Alexandre Dumas wrote The Three Musketeers.
entries.zh: 1844 年，法国作家大仲马写了《三个火枪手》。

entries.en: The story is about a young man called D’Artagnan who goes to Paris to join the Musketeers, special soldiers who protect the king.
entries.zh: 故事讲一个叫达达尼昂的年轻人去巴黎加入火枪手，那是保护国王的特别士兵。

entries.en: He meets Athos, Aramis and Porthos, three friends who are the greatest Musketeers in France, and they have many adventures together.
entries.zh: 他遇到了阿多斯、阿拉米斯和波尔多斯，这三位朋友是法国最厉害的火枪手，他们一起经历了很多冒险。

entries.en: They often say ‘one for all and all for one’, which shows their strong friendship.
entries.zh: 他们常说“人人为我，我为人人”，这体现了他们深厚的友谊。

entries.en: The Jungle Book, 1894 by Rudyard Kipling is a story about animals who are very like people.
entries.zh: 1894 年鲁德亚德·吉卜林的《丛林之书》讲的是一些很像人的动物的故事。

entries.en: Some good, some not so good.
entries.zh: 有些好，有些不那么好。

entries.en: But there is also Mowgli, a small human boy who grows up in the Indian jungle.
entries.zh: 但里面还有莫格利，一个在印度丛林里长大的小男孩。

entries.en: Many animals want to find him because he knows how to make fire.
entries.zh: 很多动物都想找到他，因为他会生火。

entries.en: Mowgli’s great friend and guardian is a bear called Baloo and also a black panther called Bagheera, who help him to escape from the tiger, Shere Khan.
entries.zh: 莫格利的好朋友和守护者是一只叫巴鲁的熊，还有一只叫巴吉拉的黑豹，它们帮他逃脱老虎谢尔·汗。

entries.en: The Lord of the Rings, 1937 to 1949 by JRR Tolkien is a fantasy story about Frodo who gets a ring from his uncle Bilbo Baggins.
entries.zh: 《指环王》（1937 至 1949 年）是 JRR·托尔金写的奇幻故事，讲弗罗多从叔叔比尔博·巴金斯那里得到一枚戒指。

entries.en: Frodo lives in a place called the Shire in Middle Earth and has a friend, Sam.
entries.zh: 弗罗多住在中土世界的夏尔，有一个朋友叫山姆。

entries.en: When Frodo leaves the Shire on a long journey with the ring, Sam as well as some other friends goes with him.
entries.zh: 当弗罗多带着戒指离开夏尔踏上漫长旅程时，山姆和其他几位朋友一起跟着他。

entries.en: Sam’s friendship is very important for Frodo as he faces many dangerous situations; Sam is always there to help him.
entries.zh: 山姆的友谊对弗罗多非常重要，因为他要面对许多危险处境；山姆总在他身边帮助他。

entries.en: A more modern book is My Brilliant Friend, 2011 by Elena Ferrante.
entries.zh: 更现代的一本书是 2011 年埃莱娜·费兰特的《我的天才女友》。

entries.en: It is the first of a series of four novels.
entries.zh: 它是四部曲系列的第一部。

entries.en: The story begins in Naples in the 1950s.
entries.zh: 故事发生在 20 世纪 50 年代的那不勒斯。

entries.en: Elena and Lila are friends at school but they have a lot of arguments, too.
entries.zh: 埃莱娜和莉拉是学校里的朋友，但也经常吵架。

entries.en: As they grow up life takes them away from each other, but when they are both old things happen that bring them together again.
entries.zh: 随着长大，生活让她们分开，但当她们都老了，事情又让她们重新走到一起。
